purpose: ChatGPT output consumed by the local deterministic Portfolio runtime.
hard_rules: Return one JSON file named Portfolio_Grading_Result.json.
Do not build Portfolio state, reports, PDFs, PowerSchool CSVs, or a GitHub transfer for a grading request.
parent_state sha256/state_version/state_id must be copied exactly from REQUEST.json.
Every judgment must use a student_key from grading_context.json and an exact current i_can_id.
Map the clean task before judging the response.
Repeated prompts for the same I Can on the same source are not automatically independent opportunities.
NOT_OBSERVED means the target was not defensibly observed and is not appended as an evidence event. UNUSABLE means the student attempted/provided material but it is not defensible evidence.
NO_SUBMISSION belongs in no_submission_student_keys rather than as an evidence judgment.

judgments.note: Separates the direct observation from the inference accurately.

class_insights.highest_leverage_pattern: Optional concise class-level pattern grounded in the graded evidence.

whole_class.why: Optional reason for Whole Class routing.
